name: mysql
patches: Replace rustls-pemfile with rustls::pki_types::pem::PemObject; preserve TLS trust and client identity behavior.
Resolve mysql_common to the verified local copy with the fixed zstd dependency.
Add opt-in completed result metadata snapshots and immediate abort for CLI consumers; expose TLS connection state.
Honor CLIENT_DEPRECATE_EOF when reading column metadata; do not discard the first row.
Try remaining resolved TCP addresses after a connection refusal instead of stopping at the first address.
